On arrival I made contact with the victim, ⟦name|Shelby McAllister-Dunn⟧ (V1), who stated she parked her 2019 Honda CR-V in the driveway at approx. 2300 hrs on 10/03 and found the rear passenger window smashed when she came out to leave for work at approx. 0645 hrs. ⟦name|Shelby⟧ stated her work laptop, her purse and her wallet were left on the back seat under a jacket.

V1 stated her neighbor ⟦name|Lamar⟧ (W1) told her he heard glass break "sometime after 3" and saw a male walking fast toward Copley Rd. I spoke w/ W1 at his residence. W1 stated he was up letting his dog out, looked out his front window and observed a thin male in a dark hoodie and an orange Joe Burrow jersey. W1 stated "I only noticed because nobody on this street wears Bengals stuff, it's all Browns." W1 could not see the male's face and did not see a vehicle.

V1 has a Ring doorbell camera; the camera faces the porch and only partially covers the driveway. V1 advised the Ring account is under her username ⟦username|shelbyrae93⟧ and she would share the clip through the Neighbors app referencing the case #. V1 stated she had already cancelled the Visa card and called Summa IT at 330-555-2911 to remote-lock the laptop. V1 provided her cell, ⟦phone number|330 555 0168⟧, for follow-up.

No latent prints recovered (glass fragmented, door handles wet from rain). Photos taken and uploaded to Evidence.com under 26-118447. Canvassed 1170-1200 blk of Delia Ave. Resident at ⟦street address|1194 Delia Ave⟧, Mrs. ⟦name|Gloria Estep-Raines⟧, stated she has a camera over her garage and will check her footage; ⟦name|Gloria⟧ can be reached at ⟦phone number|(330) 555-7034⟧. Two other residents not home, cards left.

Similar MO (rear window, ceramic, laptop bags) reported 10/01 on Diagonal Rd (26-116902) and 10/02 on Mull Ave (26-117355). Forwarded to Property Crimes for pattern review.

I am the person named above. I work as a dispenser at the Boots pharmacy on Gallowtree Gate in Leicester city centre and have done for six years.

On Friday 19th September 2026 I finished work at 17:30. I left with my colleague ⟦name|Bronagh McAleese⟧ and we walked together to the Haymarket bus station to get the 48 home. We were stood at stand K under the shelter at about 17:40. It was still light and dry. There is a big poster on the side of the bus station of Gary Lineker advertising crisps, and I remember that because ⟦name|Bronagh⟧ made a joke about it.

I noticed two men arguing near the bins by the entrance to the Haymarket Centre, about 10 metres from me. The first man was white, about 30-35, ginger beard cut short, shaved head, wearing a grey North Face puffer jacket, grey joggers and white trainers. He had "LCFC" tattooed on the side of his neck in dark green letters. I know this man by sight as "⟦name|Dazza⟧". He has come into the pharmacy maybe 10 or 12 times in the last year and the other staff call him that. I do not know his full name and I have not looked it up.

The second man was older, Asian, maybe 60s or 70s, wearing a flat cap and a navy blazer and carrying a Sainsbury's bag for life. A lady was with him, also older, in a lilac salwar kameez.

I heard "⟦name|Dazza⟧" shout "you think you're better than me" or words to that effect, and then he swung his right fist and hit the older man on the left side of his face. The older man fell backwards and the back of his head hit the kerb. I heard it. He did not put his hands out. The lady was screaming "⟦name|Mohinder⟧! ⟦name|Mohinder⟧!" and kneeling over him.

"⟦name|Dazza⟧" stood over him for a second, then walked off quickly towards Belgrave Gate, not running. He looked back once. I saw his face clearly for about 3 or 4 seconds from the side and the front. Nothing was blocking my view.

⟦name|Bronagh⟧ rang 999. I went over and stayed with the older man and put my coat under his head. He was breathing but not speaking properly and there was blood coming from the back of his head. A man in a hi-vis jacket from the bus station came over and helped. The ambulance arrived at about 17:55 and the police shortly after.

At about 18:20 I rang my husband ⟦name|Callum⟧ on ⟦phone number|07700 900417⟧ to tell him I would be late, and he came to pick me up.

I would recognise "⟦name|Dazza⟧" again. I have not been shown any photographs and I have not discussed what I saw with anyone except ⟦name|Bronagh⟧ on the night and the police.

I am willing to attend court if required.
